coverage_note: Noon is evidenced as a UAE/KSA/Egypt shopping, grocery, food, send, and delivery platform. This skeleton activates only UAE Atlas waterfront geometry; KSA/Egypt and other Gulf markets remain narrative/future scope until local Atlas overlap and use cases are grounded.

partner_context.their_ambition: You are the Gulf’s commerce and delivery surface — shopping, grocery, food, send, and fast delivery in one consumer app.
partner_context.their_pressure: The UAE’s highest-value customers cluster around marinas, islands, resorts, event venues, and waterfront districts where road movement is often indirect and premium expectations are high.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier gives Noon a marine leg for premium delivery, concierge transfer, event logistics, and experience bundles using sealed Atlas waterfront geometry rather than a new standalone ferry brand.

hero.title: Noon × Navier — commerce and concierge logistics, now on the water
hero.subtitle: The UAE’s waterfront demand is dense, premium, and app-native. Noon can make the marine leg feel as normal as delivery.
hero.what_we_do_together: Launch a Noon-visible foiling water layer across UAE marina, island, resort, and event districts: premium customer movement, high-value courier hops, hotel/concierge bundles, and experience logistics routed through the same app surface Noon already owns.

why_now: The UAE is concentrating residential, tourism, restaurant, hotel, and event demand on waterfront districts while marine mobility is being actively modernized. Navier adds a fast, smooth, low-noise foiling layer that uses existing water and berth infrastructure, so Noon can extend its app-native convenience from roads to the coast without waiting for new land corridors.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the vessel clear of chop: faster, smoother, quieter, and far more efficient than conventional small craft.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: The network uses existing water and berth infrastructure instead of new roads, rails, or vertiports.
why_navier_now.the_moment: UAE waterfront growth, premium tourism, and app-native delivery expectations are converging; the water layer can be claimed before it becomes a commodity.
